description: This file defines models and a fetcher class for retrieving and processing historical equity data from the Tradier API, including query parameter handling, data transformation, and API request logic.

classes.name: TradierEquityHistoricalQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for Tradier equity historical data requests, including symbol list, interval, and extended hours flag.

classes.name: TradierEquityHistoricalData
classes.description: Represents the historical equity data with fields for timestamp and last price.

classes.name: TradierEquityHistoricalFetcher
classes.description: Handles fetching, transforming, and validating historical equity data from Tradier API.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms input parameters into a standardized query object, setting default date ranges based on interval.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches raw data from the Tradier API for given symbols and query parameters.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API data into validated TradierEquityHistoricalData objects, sorted by date or timestamp.
